2	  "title": "Cross-survey latent consistency: the trunk feature of a place must be the same in all three photographs, not three fingerprints that happen to share a label",
3	  "category": "loss",
4	  "hypothesis": "Experiment 2 produced exactly the clean negative its own pre-registration named: the three training photographs now converge (train_capture_diagnostics 0.060 / 0.053 / 0.088, 94-96% usable on each) while the held-out 2024 photograph barely moved (1.651 -> 1.583, 7% usable, 65% false fix). So 3 MB of weights and a 160-d pooled feature hold THREE separate pixel-fingerprints per 128 m cell with room to spare, and nothing in the current training signal objects: the soft cross-entropy only asks that three different feature vectors all point into the same logit direction, which a linear head satisfies trivially by carving three regions of feature space per cell. A fourth exposure of the same ground lands in none of those three regions, and the fix is confidently wrong. The missing signal is one that acts on the FEATURE the classifier reads, not on the classifier's answer: at every lattice position the paired batch already holds the same ground in all three surveys under one shared heading, so pull each survey's L2-normalised trunk feature toward the stop-gradient mean of the other surveys' features at that position (cosine loss). The classifier then cannot store three fingerprints, because the three must be one vector; whatever survives the pull is the structure the three photographs share (block layout, road geometry, building footprints, water) and the canopy/shadow/colour-balance cues that differ between a summer, a leaf-off and an early-spring survey are penalised. That is the library's L2 entry #1 (cross-survey latent consistency, the top rung of the SSL4EO ladder and the mechanism every cross-date aerial result was trained with), applied directly to the 160-d GAP feature rather than through a projector: a projector would let the feature keep its survey-specific content and discard it only in the projection, which is the opposite of what the linear cell head needs. No VICReg variance hinge: collapse is impossible while a 2,970-way cross-entropy is trained on the same vector. Output-level consistency (KL between the three cell distributions) would NOT work here, because experiment 2 already achieves near-identical argmaxes across the three surveys; the three-fingerprint solution satisfies output consistency perfectly and only feature-level consistency forbids it.",
5	  "method": "ONE change: add a cross-survey feature-consistency loss during training, with position-grouped mini-batches so every batch holds P positions x 3 captures. In model/model.py, training_outputs() additionally returns the pooled 160-d trunk feature f, and a new consistency_loss(f, n_caps) computes, for rows ordered position-major, fn = normalize(f).view(P, K, D), target_k = detach((sum_j fn_j - fn_k) / (K-1)), loss = mean_k(1 - <fn_k, target_k>). In model/train.py, mini-batches are drawn as whole positions (BATCH_SIZE // n_caps = 21 positions x 3 captures = 63 views) instead of shuffled single views, and the total loss becomes loss_fn(...) + CONS_WEIGHT * consistency_loss(...) with CONS_WEIGHT = 2.0. The per-epoch log line and train_info.json gain the mean cross-survey cosine and the consistency loss so the next experiment can read whether the term bit. Inference graph, ONNX export, decode, cell/offset targets, schedule and epoch budget are untouched.",
6	  "expected_outcome": "Diagnostic that must move for the mechanism to count as applied: the logged mean cross-survey cosine of the trunk feature rises above 0.9 by the last epoch (experiment 2 never measured it; three independent fingerprints would sit well below). Primary (held-out truedop_2024): 1.583 -> predicted 1.1-1.4, with false-fix rate falling from 65% to below 50% as features stop keying on one raster's intensities and texture, and usable rising from 7% to 15-30%. Training diagnostics (bb_dop20 / truedop_2022 / truedop_2023) are expected to WORSEN mildly, from 0.05-0.09 to 0.1-0.3, because the model is forbidden its easiest solution; that is acceptable and is the sign the capacity moved from fingerprints to shared structure. Decision rules on the result: (a) cosine > 0.9 and 2024 improves -> supported; the next step layers L2 #2 (photometric + jitter augmentation) on top. (b) cosine > 0.9 but 2024 stays >= 1.5 -> invariance across these three surveys does not reach a fourth; the gap is then beyond what paired consistency alone can close and the next move is the distillation route (L2 #3) or augmentation. (c) cosine stays < 0.8 at CONS_WEIGHT 2.0 -> the cross-entropy out-muscled the term; rerun with a larger weight or a feature bottleneck before concluding anything about invariance. Standing check: the score must improve through usable_fix_rate, not through coverage collapsing (coverage must stay >= 0.2 and ideally near experiment 2's 72%).",
7	  "init_strategy": "from-scratch",
8	  "eli5": "Last time we showed the model three different photographs of Berlin at once, hoping it would learn what the city looks like. Instead it did the lazy thing: it memorised three separate photo albums and just agreed on the captions. Shown a fourth photograph, it had no album for it and guessed wrong, confidently. This experiment adds a rule during study: when you look at the same street corner in the summer photo, the winter photo and the spring photo, the picture you form in your head has to be THE SAME picture. That forces it to notice the things that do not change between photographs, like the shape of the blocks and the roads, and to stop leaning on the colour of the trees or the shadows that day. A fourth photograph should then look familiar.",
9	  "architecture": {
10	    "stages": [
11	      {"name": "Camera frame", "detail": "128×128 px daytime crop, Berlin only; trained on three survey photographs, scored on a fourth it never saw", "changed": false},
12	      {"name": "Feature extractor", "detail": "small strided conv stack that turns the frame into a compact texture fingerprint (last layer 160 channels)", "changed": false},
13	      {"name": "Map-cell classifier", "detail": "scores all ~3,000 128 m map tiles of Berlin and picks the tile this view belongs to — localization as multiple choice, not coordinate guessing", "changed": false},
14	      {"name": "Local belief pooling", "detail": "gathers the belief spread over the winning tile AND its 8 neighbours, and places the fix at the balance point of that local cluster instead of snapping to one tile's centre", "changed": false},
15	      {"name": "Within-cell offset", "detail": "small head that nudges the fix from the pooled balance point to the exact spot", "changed": false},
16	      {"name": "Confidence gate", "detail": "confidence = the belief mass on the winning tile plus its 8 neighbours — a vote split across adjacent tiles still counts as knowing where you are; belief scattered across distant tiles still reads as unsure and the drone abstains", "changed": false},
17	      {"name": "Training signal", "detail": "NEW: on top of the tile labels, the fingerprint the extractor produces for one place must be the SAME in all three survey photographs — each photo's fingerprint is pulled toward the average of the other two (cosine, no gradient through the target). Batches are built as whole places × three photos so the pull is always available. Labels, loss on tiles, schedule and views per epoch unchanged.", "changed": true, "train_only": true}
18	    ]
19	  },
20	  "implementation_brief": "Two files change: model/model.py and model/train.py. Copy nothing from older runs; the current code (which is runs/20261030_101727_experiment2/model_src/) is the starting point and most of it stays verbatim.

=== model/model.py ===
1. In CellLocNet, add a method `embed(self, x)` returning `self.features(x).mean(dim=(2, 3))` (the 160-d pooled feature). Change `training_outputs(self, x)` to compute `f = self.embed(x)` and return the THREE-tuple `(self.cls_head(f), torch.tanh(self.off_head(f)) * 0.5, f)`. Update `forward()` to unpack `logits, offset, _ = self.training_outputs(x)`; everything else in forward() (softmax, argmax, 3x3 mask, pooled centroid, offset nudge, clamp, stack) stays byte-identical, so the exported graph is unchanged.
2. Add a module-level function:
```
def consistency_loss(f: torch.Tensor, n_caps: int):
    """Cross-survey feature consistency. f is [P*K, D], rows ordered
    POSITION-MAJOR: row p*K + k is position p, capture k.
    Each capture's L2-normalised feature is pulled toward the detached
    mean of the OTHER captures' normalised features at the same position
    (cosine loss). Returns (loss, mean_cosine_detached). K == 1 -> (0, 1)."""
    if n_caps < 2:
        z = f.new_zeros(())
        return z, z + 1.0
    fn = F.normalize(f, dim=1).view(-1, n_caps, f.shape[1])      # [P, K, D]
    other = (fn.sum(dim=1, keepdim=True) - fn) / (n_caps - 1)   # [P, K, D]
    other = F.normalize(other.detach(), dim=2)
    cos = (fn * other).sum(dim=2)                                # [P, K]
    return (1.0 - cos).mean(), cos.detach().mean()
```
Keep `loss_fn` exactly as it is (same signature, same body). Keep CELL_PX, grid_dims, build_model, export_onnx, estimate_position untouched. Update the module docstring with one paragraph describing the consistency term (train-only, not in the graph).

=== model/train.py ===
3. Add a constant next to BATCH_SIZE: `CONS_WEIGHT = 2.0  # weight of the cross-survey feature-consistency loss`. Import `consistency_loss` from model.model.
4. `extract_chunk` already emits rows position-major (outer loop over positions, inner loop over captures) — keep it exactly as is, and add a comment stating that row p*K + k is position p, capture k, and that the consistency loss relies on this ordering.
5. In `train_area`, replace the mini-batch loop. Currently: `perm = torch.randperm(n)` over single views and `idx = perm[i:i + BATCH_SIZE]`. New: `n_pos = n // n_caps` (assert `n == n_pos * n_caps`), `pos_per_batch = max(1, BATCH_SIZE // n_caps)`, `pos_perm = torch.randperm(n_pos)`, and for `i in range(0, n_pos, pos_per_batch)`: `pidx = pos_perm[i:i + pos_per_batch]`; `idx = (pidx.unsqueeze(1) * n_caps + torch.arange(n_caps)).reshape(-1)`. This gives position-major batches of up to 21 positions x 3 captures = 63 views. Everything indexed by `idx` (x_u8, cell_idx, pos, cap_idx) stays as before.
6. In the step: `logits, off_pred, feat = model.training_outputs(xb)`; soft targets and residual offset target unchanged; `cons, cos_mean = consistency_loss(feat, n_caps)`; `loss = loss_fn(logits, off_pred, soft_t, off_t) + CONS_WEIGHT * cons`. Accumulate `cons_sum += cons.item() * len(idx)` and `cos_sum += float(cos_mean) * len(idx)` alongside loss_sum, and print `cons={cons_sum/seen:.4f} xsurvey_cos={cos_sum/seen:.4f}` on the per-epoch log line. Keep every existing log field (loss, top1, mean_max_softmax, views, lr, top1_by_capture).
7. In the returned info dict, keep every existing key and add: `"consistency_weight": CONS_WEIGHT`, `"final_consistency_loss": round(cons_sum/seen, 4)`, `"final_xsurvey_cosine": round(cos_sum/seen, 4)`, `"positions_per_batch": pos_per_batch`, and change `"capture_sampling"` to `"paired-position interleave, shared heading per position, position-grouped batches + cross-survey feature consistency"`. Update the module docstring with a short CROSS-SURVEY CONSISTENCY paragraph (what the term is, that batches are position-grouped, CONS_WEIGHT).

=== Contracts to preserve (the frozen scorer depends on them) ===
- CLI of model/train.py unchanged: `python -m model.train --area <a> --out-dir <dir> [--data-dir D] [--epochs N] [--max-crops-per-bucket M] [--seed S]`; it writes/appends `<out>/train_info.json` and prints the info dict as JSON on the last line.
- ONNX contract from model/model.py's docstring: one file at `<out>/models/<area>.onnx`, input `frame` 1x3x128x128 float32 in [0,1], output `uvc` = [[u, v, conf]] with u, v normalised map coords in [0,1] and conf in [0,1]; the whole decode stays inside the graph; opset 17, dynamo=False. forward() must not reference the consistency machinery.
- Training reads only `buckets(meta, "train")` via load_scene; never open the eval capture (truedop_2024) in any form.
- Deployment gates: exported size must stay <= 4 MiB (unchanged architecture, 3.08 MB) and host latency proxy <= 250 ms (unchanged graph).
- Epoch budget: views per epoch unchanged (len(crops) * len(imgs)); the added cost is a few ops on a [63,160] tensor per step, so wall-clock stays ~58 min at 8 epochs on the M1.
- Genericity: n_caps == 1 (an area with a single capture) must still train: consistency_loss returns zero and the batch loop degenerates to plain batches of BATCH_SIZE views.

Sanity check before exiting: run `.venv/bin/python -c "import torch; from model.model import CellLocNet, consistency_loss; m = CellLocNet({'width': 7000, 'height': 6900}); x = torch.rand(6, 3, 128, 128); l, o, f = m.training_outputs(x); c, cs = consistency_loss(f, 3); print(l.shape, o.shape, f.shape, float(c), float(cs)); print(m(x).shape)"` and confirm shapes [6, n_cells], [6, 2], [6, 160], a finite loss, and forward output [6, 3]. Also build a tiny chunk (e.g. 4 positions x 3 captures) with the new batch indexing and assert every batch's rows come in consecutive triples of one position."
21	}

129	def converge(gx, gs, tx, color, cells="all", n=8):
130	    """Decode drawn as cell-centers voting: lines from grid cells to a point."""
131	    out = []
132	    src = []
133	    y0 = IC - gs / 2
134	    if cells == "all":
135	        xs = ys = range(n)
136	    else:
137	        # 5x5 refinement window: cols 3-7, rows 1-5 — must match the red
138	        # window rect exp3 draws (wx = gx+3gs/8, wy = y0+1gs/8), so every
139	        # vote line starts at a cell center INSIDE the drawn window.
140	        xs, ys = range(3, 8), range(1, 6)
141	    for gyy in ys:
142	        for gxx in xs:
143	            if cells == "all" and (gxx + gyy) % 2:
144	                continue
145	            src.append((gx + (gxx + 0.5) * gs / n, y0 + (gyy + 0.5) * gs / n))
146	    for (sx, sy) in src:
147	        out.append(f"<line x1='{sx:.0f}' y1='{sy:.0f}' x2='{tx}' y2='{IC}' "
148	                   f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' opacity='0.4'/>")

174	def kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, color):
175	    """Conv connection: small kernel square on layer i's face, faint lines
176	    converging to a cell on layer i+1 — computed-from, not standing-next-to."""
177	    k = max(5, s1 * 0.30)
178	    kx, ky = x1 + s1 * 0.60, IC - s1 / 2 + s1 * 0.18
179	    c = max(3, s2 * 0.14)
180	    cx, cy = x2 + s2 * 0.22, IC - s2 / 2 + s2 * 0.26
181	    out = [f"<rect x='{kx:.1f}' y='{ky:.1f}' width='{k:.1f}' height='{k:.1f}' "
182	           f"fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.9'/>",
183	           f"<rect x='{cx:.1f}' y='{cy:.1f}' width='{c:.1f}' height='{c:.1f}' "
184	           f"fill='{color}' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='none'/>"]
185	    for (px, py) in ((kx, ky), (kx + k, ky), (kx, ky + k), (kx + k, ky + k)):
186	        out.append(f"<line x1='{px:.1f}' y1='{py:.1f}' x2='{cx + c / 2:.1f}' "
187	                   f"y2='{cy + c / 2:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' "
188	                   f"opacity='0.45'/>")
189	    return "".join(out)

192	def conv_group(x0, colors=None, prev=None):
193	    """The shared encoder: the four conv OUTPUT tensors as slabs (64²×16 →
194	    8²×128); each of the 4 convs is a kernel projection — the first from the
195	    input image itself (prev=(x, s, color))."""
196	    sizes = [(46, 7), (34, 11), (24, 15), (17, 21)]
197	    out, x, faces = [], x0, []
198	    for i, (s, d) in enumerate(sizes):
199	        g, w = slab(x, s, d, (colors or [INK] * 4)[i])
200	        out.append(g)
201	        faces.append((x, s))
202	        x += w + 15
203	    x -= 15
204	    if prev:

"""Technical architecture diagrams for experiments 1-6, drawn in tensor-native
visual language: images/fields as real grids, feature maps as 3D slabs,
vectors as tick-bars, FC as connection fans, decodes as lines converging to a
point. Captions sit under elements; no labeled boxes."""
import math
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]))
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).resolve().parent))
from autoresearch.db import connect
from terrain_frame_glyph import terrain_frame

INK, MUT, FAINT, ACC, OCH = "#111111", "#6b6a60", "#9b998c", "#8c2f1f", "#8a6a1e"
FONT = "Palatino,Georgia,serif"
IC = 112          # inference lane center y
LOSS_Y = 292      # loss-annotation row baseline


def txt(x, y, s, size=10, color=MUT, w=400, anchor="middle", style="", tid=None):
    tid_attr = f"id='{tid}' " if tid else ""
    return (f"<text {tid_attr}x='{x:.0f}' y='{y:.0f}' font-family='{FONT}' font-size='{size}' "
            f"fill='{color}' font-weight='{w}' text-anchor='{anchor}' {style}>{s}</text>")


def cap(xc, y, name, sub=None, color=MUT, name_color=None):
    out = [txt(xc, y, name, 10.5, name_color or (INK if color == MUT else color), 600)]
    if sub:
        out.append(txt(xc, y + 12, sub, 9.5, color))
    return "".join(out)


def harrow(x1, x2, y, label=None, color=FAINT):
    out = [f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y}' x2='{x2 - 5}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
           f"<path d='M {x2},{y} l -6,-3 v 6 Z' fill='{color}'/>"]
    if label:
        out.append(txt((x1 + x2) / 2, y - 6, label, 9, FAINT, style="font-style='italic'"))
    return "".join(out)


def leader(x1, y1, x2, y2, color):
    """Slanted dashed annotation leader, paper-margin style."""
    return (f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{y1}' x2='{x2}' y2='{y2}' stroke='{color}' "
            f"stroke-width='1' stroke-dasharray='2 4'/>")


def slab(x, s, d, color=INK):
    """Pseudo-3D feature-map slab: front s x s, depth d. Returns (svg, width)."""
    y = IC - s / 2
    dx, dy = d, d * 0.55
    out = [
        f"<polygon points='{x},{y} {x+dx},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+s},{y}' "
        f"fill='#00000010' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<polygon points='{x+s},{y} {x+dx+s},{y-dy} {x+dx+s},{y-dy+s} {x+s},{y+s}' "
        f"fill='#0000001c' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1'/>",
        f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='#00000006' "
        f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>",
    ]
    return "".join(out), s + dx


def imgsq(x, s, color=INK, tid=None):
    """Input image: square with a sparse pixel-grid texture."""
    y = IC - s / 2
    tid_attr = f"id='{tid}' " if tid else ""
    out = [f"<rect {tid_attr}x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='#00000008' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"]
    n = 6
    for i in range(1, n):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x + i * s / n:.0f}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + i * s / n:.0f}' "
                   f"y2='{y + s}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.4' opacity='0.3'/>")
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * s / n:.0f}' x2='{x + s}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * s / n:.0f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.4' opacity='0.3'/>")
    for (a, b, o) in ((1, 2, .35), (3, 1, .5), (2, 4, .4), (4, 3, .3), (0, 4, .25), (4, 0, .3)):
        out.append(f"<rect x='{x + a * s / n:.0f}' y='{y + b * s / n:.0f}' "
                   f"width='{s / n:.0f}' height='{s / n:.0f}' fill='{color}' opacity='{o * 0.35}'/>")
    return "".join(out), s


def bar(x, h, color=INK, ticks=9):
    """1-D vector as a thin vertical tick-bar."""
    y = IC - h / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='7' height='{h}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>"]
    for i in range(1, ticks):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' x2='{x + 7}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * h / ticks:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.5'/>")
    return "".join(out), 7


def fan(x1, h1, x2, h2, color=FAINT, n=5):
    """Fully-connected layer as a fan of crossing connections."""
    out = []
    for i in range(n):
        ya = IC - h1 / 2 + (i + 0.5) * h1 / n
        for j in range(n):
            yb = IC - h2 / 2 + (j + 0.5) * h2 / n
            out.append(f"<line x1='{x1}' y1='{ya:.1f}' x2='{x2}' y2='{yb:.1f}' "
                       f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.5' opacity='0.45'/>")
    return "".join(out)


def gridsq(x, s, n, color=INK, bumps=(), yc=None, lw=1.2):
    yc = IC if yc is None else yc
    y = yc - s / 2
    out = [f"<rect x='{x}' y='{y}' width='{s}' height='{s}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='{lw}'/>"]
    for i in range(1, n):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + i * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{y + s}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.5'/>")
        out.append(f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' x2='{x + s}' "
                   f"y2='{y + i * s / n:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.45' opacity='0.5'/>")
    for (gx, gy, o) in bumps:
        out.append(f"<rect x='{x + gx * s / n:.1f}' y='{y + gy * s / n:.1f}' "
                   f"width='{s / n:.1f}' height='{s / n:.1f}' fill='{color}' fill-opacity='{o}'/>")
    return "".join(out), s


BUMP = ((5, 2, .55), (4, 2, .28), (5, 1, .28), (6, 2, .18), (5, 3, .18), (2, 5, .12), (1, 6, .1))


def crosspt(x, y, color, r=7):
    return (f"<line x1='{x - r}' y1='{y}' x2='{x + r}' y2='{y}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{y - r}' x2='{x}' y2='{y + r}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='{r * 0.55:.1f}' fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{y}' r='1.5' fill='{color}'/>")


def converge(gx, gs, tx, color, cells="all", n=8):
    """Decode drawn as cell-centers voting: lines from grid cells to a point."""
    out = []
    src = []
    y0 = IC - gs / 2
    if cells == "all":
        xs = ys = range(n)
    else:
        # 5x5 refinement window: cols 3-7, rows 1-5 — must match the red
        # window rect exp3 draws (wx = gx+3gs/8, wy = y0+1gs/8), so every
        # vote line starts at a cell center INSIDE the drawn window.
        xs, ys = range(3, 8), range(1, 6)
    for gyy in ys:
        for gxx in xs:
            if cells == "all" and (gxx + gyy) % 2:
                continue
            src.append((gx + (gxx + 0.5) * gs / n, y0 + (gyy + 0.5) * gs / n))
    for (sx, sy) in src:
        out.append(f"<line x1='{sx:.0f}' y1='{sy:.0f}' x2='{tx}' y2='{IC}' "
                   f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' opacity='0.4'/>")

def gauge(x, yc, color=MUT, r=14):
    a = math.radians(55)
    return (f"<path d='M {x - r},{yc} A {r} {r} 0 0 1 {x + r},{yc}' fill='none' "
            f"stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.2'/>"
            f"<line x1='{x}' y1='{yc}' x2='{x + (r - 3) * math.cos(a):.1f}' "
            f"y2='{yc - (r - 3) * math.sin(a):.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='1.4'/>"
            f"<circle cx='{x}' cy='{yc}' r='1.6' fill='{color}'/>")


def lanes(h):
    return (txt(8, 26, "INFERENCE PATH — WHAT FLIES", 9, FAINT, 600, "start",
                "letter-spacing='1.8'")
            + txt(8, LOSS_Y - 34, "TRAINING SIGNALS — NEVER FLY", 9, OCH, 600, "start",
                  "letter-spacing='1.8'"))


def svgwrap(h, body):
    return (f"<svg viewBox='0 0 980 {h}' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' role='img'>"
            f"{body}</svg>")


def kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, color):
    """Conv connection: small kernel square on layer i's face, faint lines
    converging to a cell on layer i+1 — computed-from, not standing-next-to."""
    k = max(5, s1 * 0.30)
    kx, ky = x1 + s1 * 0.60, IC - s1 / 2 + s1 * 0.18
    c = max(3, s2 * 0.14)
    cx, cy = x2 + s2 * 0.22, IC - s2 / 2 + s2 * 0.26
    out = [f"<rect x='{kx:.1f}' y='{ky:.1f}' width='{k:.1f}' height='{k:.1f}' "
           f"fill='none' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.9'/>",
           f"<rect x='{cx:.1f}' y='{cy:.1f}' width='{c:.1f}' height='{c:.1f}' "
           f"fill='{color}' fill-opacity='0.5' stroke='none'/>"]
    for (px, py) in ((kx, ky), (kx + k, ky), (kx, ky + k), (kx + k, ky + k)):
        out.append(f"<line x1='{px:.1f}' y1='{py:.1f}' x2='{cx + c / 2:.1f}' "
                   f"y2='{cy + c / 2:.1f}' stroke='{color}' stroke-width='0.55' "
                   f"opacity='0.45'/>")
    return "".join(out)


def conv_group(x0, colors=None, prev=None):
    """The shared encoder: the four conv OUTPUT tensors as slabs (64²×16 →
    8²×128); each of the 4 convs is a kernel projection — the first from the
    input image itself (prev=(x, s, color))."""
    sizes = [(46, 7), (34, 11), (24, 15), (17, 21)]
    out, x, faces = [], x0, []
    for i, (s, d) in enumerate(sizes):
        g, w = slab(x, s, d, (colors or [INK] * 4)[i])
        out.append(g)
        faces.append((x, s))
        x += w + 15
    x -= 15
    if prev:
        out.append(kernel_proj(prev[0], prev[1], faces[0][0], faces[0][1], prev[2]))
    for (x1, s1), (x2, s2) in zip(faces, faces[1:]):
        out.append(kernel_proj(x1, s1, x2, s2, MUT))
    xc = (x0 + x) / 2
    out.append(cap(xc, IC + 58, "convolutional encoder", "Conv 3×3, stride 2 ×4 · BN + ReLU"))
    out.append(txt(x0 + 23, IC - 36, "64²×16", 9, FAINT))
    out.append(txt(x - 20, IC - 32, "8²×128", 9, FAINT))
    return "".join(out), x


def frame_part():
    # canonical 76x76 nadir-terrain glyph (prompt.md: copy verbatim),
    # centered on the inference lane; captions stay centered on x=53
    g = terrain_frame(IC - 38)
    out = (g + txt(53, IC - 44, "128²×3", 9, FAINT)
           + txt(53, IC + 48, "camera frame", 10.5, MUT, 600)
           + txt(53, IC + 60, "one night exposure", 9.5, FAINT)
           + txt(53, IC + 73, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT,
                 style="font-style='italic'"))
    return out, 26 + 76


def conf_branch(bar_x, out_x, color=FAINT):
    gx = bar_x + 4
    ex = out_x + 28
    out = [leader(gx, IC + 64, gx, 216, FAINT),
           gauge(gx, 230, MUT),
           txt(gx, 248, "confidence 0–1", 9, MUT),
           f"<path d='M {gx + 18},230 H {ex} V {IC + 26}' fill='none' "
           f"stroke='{FAINT}' stroke-width='0.8'/>",
           f"<path d='M {ex},{IC + 20} l -3,6 h 6 Z' fill='{FAINT}'/>",
           txt((gx + ex) / 2, 224, "may abstain instead of guessing", 8.5, FAINT,
               style="font-style='italic'")]
    return "".join(out)


def output_part(x, sub="position fix + confidence"):
    return (txt(x, IC - 18, "frozen contract", 8.5, FAINT, anchor="start",
                style="font-style='italic'")
            + txt(x, IC - 2, "(lat, lon, confidence)", 13, MUT, 600, "start",
                  tid="frozen-output")
            + txt(x, IC + 12, sub, 9, FAINT, anchor="start"))


def loss_note(x_from, y_from, x_lab, text, color, glyph=None):
    out = [leader(x_from, y_from, x_lab - 8, LOSS_Y - 16, color)]
    if glyph:
        out.append(glyph)
    out.append(txt(x_lab, LOSS_Y - 12, text[0], 10, color, 600, "start"))
    if len(text) > 1:
        out.append(txt(x_lab, LOSS_Y, text[1], 9.5, color, 400, "start"))
    return "".join(out)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exp 1
def exp1():
    b = [lanes(330)]
    g, x = frame_part(); b.append(g)
    b.append(harrow(x + 6, x + 30, IC)); x += 32
    g, x = conv_group(x, prev=(26, 76, FAINT)); b.append(g)
    b.append(harrow(x + 8, x + 30, IC)); x += 34

    b.append(txt(968, LOSS_Y - 12, "starting design — nothing changed yet", 9.5, FAINT,
                 anchor="end", style="font-style='italic'"))
    return svgwrap(330, "".join(b))


# ------------------------------------------------ shared probability-field chain
def field_chain(fc_color, field_color, dec_color, dec_cells, dec_name, dec_sub):
    b = []
    g, x = frame_part(); b.append(g)
    b.append(harrow(x + 6, x + 30, IC)); x += 32
    g, x = conv_group(x, prev=(26, 76, FAINT)); b.append(g)
    b.append(harrow(x + 8, x + 30, IC)); x += 34
    g, _ = bar(x, 64, ticks=11); b.append(g)
    b.append(cap(x + 4, IC + 46, "128-d", "GAP"))
    bar_x = x
    fx = x + 12
    g, _ = bar(fx + 60, 92, fc_color, ticks=15)
    b.append(fan(fx, 64, fx + 60, 92, FAINT if fc_color == INK else fc_color))
    b.append(g)
    b.append(cap(fx + 64, IC + 84, "FC → 1024 logits", "softmax",
                 name_color=fc_color if fc_color == ACC else None))
    x = fx + 74
    b.append(harrow(x, x + 26, IC))
    gx = x + 28
    g, gs = gridsq(gx, 76, 8, field_color, BUMP)
    b.append(g)
    b.append(cap(gx + 38, IC + 56, "probability field", "32×32 cells over the map",
                 name_color=field_color if field_color == ACC else None))

    b.append(converge(gx, 76, tx, dec_color, cells=dec_cells))
    b.append(cap((gx + gs + tx) / 2 + 4, IC - 54, dec_name, dec_sub,
                 name_color=dec_color if dec_color == ACC else None))

    b.append(conf_branch(bar_x, tx + 18))

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exp 2
def exp2():
    b, gx, gs, tx, _ = field_chain(ACC, ACC, ACC, "all",
                                   "soft-argmax over ALL cells",
                                   "answer = Σ probability · cell-center")
    body = [lanes(330)] + b

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- exp 4
def exp4():
    b = [lanes(340)]
    g, x = frame_part(); b.append(g)
    b.append(harrow(x + 6, x + 30, IC)); x += 36
    g, x = conv_group(x, prev=(26, 76, FAINT)); b.append(g)

    b.append(harrow(dil_x + w + 6, x - 6, IC))
    gx = x
    g, gs = gridsq(gx, 96, 8, ACC)
    b.append(g)
    dots = []
    for i in range(8):
        for j in range(8):
            ox = ((i * 37 + j * 53) % 9 - 4) * 0.9
            oy = ((i * 61 + j * 29) % 9 - 4) * 0.9
            dots.append((i, j, gx + (j + 0.5) * gs / 8 + ox,
                         IC - gs / 2 + (i + 0.5) * gs / 8 + oy))
    for (_, _, cx, cy) in dots:
        b.append(f"<circle cx='{cx:.1f}' cy='{cy:.1f}' r='1.3' fill='{ACC}'/>")

        body.append(g)

79	def _arc_points(x1, y1, rx, ry, rot_deg, large_arc, sweep, x2, y2, n=12):
80	    """Flatten an absolute SVG elliptical-arc command into n+1 points via
81	    the standard endpoint-to-center parametrization (SVG spec F.6.5), so
82	    curved elements (the confidence-gauge dial glyph, etc.) can be checked
83	    for crossing a label the same way straight segments already are."""
84	    if rx == 0 or ry == 0 or (x1 == x2 and y1 == y2):
85	        return [(x1, y1), (x2, y2)]
86	    phi = math.radians(rot_deg)
87	    cphi, sphi = math.cos(phi), math.sin(phi)
88	    dx, dy = (x1 - x2) / 2.0, (y1 - y2) / 2.0
89	    x1p = cphi * dx + sphi * dy
90	    y1p = -sphi * dx + cphi * dy
91	    rx, ry = abs(rx), abs(ry)
92	    lam = x1p ** 2 / rx ** 2 + y1p ** 2 / ry ** 2
93	    if lam > 1:
94	        s = math.sqrt(lam)
95	        rx, ry = rx * s, ry * s
96	    num = rx ** 2 * ry ** 2 - rx ** 2 * y1p ** 2 - ry ** 2 * x1p ** 2
97	    den = rx ** 2 * y1p ** 2 + ry ** 2 * x1p ** 2
98	    co = math.sqrt(max(0.0, num / den)) if den else 0.0
99	    if large_arc == sweep:
100	        co = -co
101	    cxp, cyp = co * rx * y1p / ry, co * -ry * x1p / rx
102	    cx = cphi * cxp - sphi * cyp + (x1 + x2) / 2.0
103	    cy = sphi * cxp + cphi * cyp + (y1 + y2) / 2.0
104	
105	    def _ang(ux, uy, vx, vy):
106	        d = math.sqrt((ux ** 2 + uy ** 2) * (vx ** 2 + vy ** 2))
107	        a = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, (ux * vx + uy * vy) / d))) if d else 0.0
108	        return -a if ux * vy - uy * vx < 0 else a
109	
110	    theta1 = _ang(1, 0, (x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry)
111	    dtheta = _ang((x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry,
112	                  (-x1p - cxp) / rx, (-y1p - cyp) / ry)
113	    if not sweep and dtheta > 0:
114	        dtheta -= 2 * math.pi
115	    if sweep and dtheta < 0:
116	        dtheta += 2 * math.pi

118	    for i in range(n + 1):
119	        t = theta1 + dtheta * i / n
120	        pts.append((cx + rx * math.cos(t) * cphi - ry * math.sin(t) * sphi,
121	                    cy + rx * math.cos(t) * sphi + ry * math.sin(t) * cphi))

182	def _clip_len(seg, box):
183	    """Length of seg inside box (Liang-Barsky)."""
184	    x1, y1, x2, y2 = seg
185	    bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = box[:4]
186	    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
187	    t0, t1 = 0.0, 1.0
188	    for p, q in ((-dx, x1 - bx0), (dx, bx1 - x1), (-dy, y1 - by0), (dy, by1 - y1)):
189	        if p == 0:
190	            if q < 0:
191	                return 0.0
192	            continue
193	        t = q / p
194	        if p < 0:
195	            t0 = max(t0, t)
196	        else:
197	            t1 = min(t1, t)
198	        if t0 > t1:
199	            return 0.0
200	    return ((dx * (t1 - t0)) ** 2 + (dy * (t1 - t0)) ** 2) ** 0.5

203	def _inside(pt, box, pad=2.0):
204	    return (box[0] - pad <= pt[0] <= box[2] + pad
205	            and box[1] - pad <= pt[1] <= box[3] + pad)

283	    errs = []

295	                          for p1, p2 in zip(chain, chain[1:]))
296	            if clipped <= 12.0:

298	            # A line/curve may legitimately END at a label (a leader line
299	            # landing on a caption) — exempt only when the chain's TRUE
300	            # start or end point (not a synthetic arc-sample point) sits in
301	            # the box and the total clipped length is little more than just
302	            # that tip; anything clipping substantially more is passing
303	            # through the label, not landing on it.
304	            tip = ((_inside(chain[0], box) or _inside(chain[-1], box))
305	                   and clipped <= 16.0)
306	            if tip:
307	                continue
308	            errs.append(f"line crosses label '{box[4]}'")
309	    return errs[:10]

326	    elif not re.search(r"\bx=['\"]26['\"]", tag.group(0)):
327	        errs.append("frozen-input element must sit at x=26 (left-flush anchor)")

332	    tag = re.search(r"<[^>]*id=['\"]frozen-output['\"][^>]*>", svg)
333	    if not tag:
334	        errs.append("missing id='frozen-output' on the output text block "
335	                    "(x=828, text-anchor='start')")
336	    else:
337	        if not re.search(r"\bx=['\"]828['\"]", tag.group(0)):
338	            errs.append("frozen-output must sit at x=828 (right anchor)")
339	        if "text-anchor='start'" not in tag.group(0) and \
340	           'text-anchor="start"' not in tag.group(0):
341	            errs.append("frozen-output must use text-anchor='start'")
342	    return errs

345	def main() -> int:
346	    src = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \
347	        REPO_ROOT / "runs" / "pending_experiment.json"
348	    if not src.exists():
349	        print(f"figcheck: {src} not found")
350	        return 1
351	    text = src.read_text()
352	    stages = None
353	    if src.suffix == ".json":
354	        d = json.loads(text)

357	    else:

import sys
from pathlib import Path

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]

# The five-color style contract (prompt_figure.md). Hex values normalized
# to lowercase before comparison. archive/arch_svg_reference.py's own pseudo-
# 3D slab shading uses '#000000xx' (black + inline alpha) for faint edge/face
# tints instead of a separate opacity attribute — that's the canonical
# reference implementation, not a violation, so '#000000' is allowed too.
_PALETTE = {"#111111", "#6b6a60", "#9b998c", "#8c2f1f", "#8a6a1e", "#000000"}
_RED = "#8c2f1f"
_FONT = "palatino,georgia,serif"
# Calibrated against archive/arch_svg_reference.py's own stroke-widths, which
# range 0.4 (faint hairline ticks) to 2 (accent highlight border) — this is a
# sanity floor/ceiling for broken values, not a tight match to "~1.2/1".
_STROKE_RANGE = (0.3, 2.2)
_EMOJI_RANGES = (
    (0x1F000, 0x1FFFF),  # emoji/pictograph/symbol blocks (SMP)
    (0x2600, 0x26FF),    # misc symbols (weather/dingbat-adjacent)
    (0x2700, 0x27BF),    # dingbats
)


def _num(attrs: str, name: str, default=None):
    m = re.search(rf"\b{name}=['\"]([-\d.]+)", attrs)
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else default


def _text_boxes(svg: str):
    """Approximate bounding boxes for unrotated <text> elements."""
    boxes = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<text([^>]*)>(.*?)</text>", svg, re.S):
        attrs, raw = m.group(1), m.group(2)
        if "transform" in attrs:
            continue
        content = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", raw)).strip()
        x, y = _num(attrs, "x"), _num(attrs, "y")
        if x is None or y is None or not content:
            continue
        fs = _num(attrs, "font-size", 11.0)
        w = len(content) * fs * 0.52          # serif average advance
        a = re.search(r"text-anchor=['\"](\w+)", attrs)
        a = a.group(1) if a else "start"
        x0 = x - w if a == "end" else x - w / 2 if a == "middle" else x
        boxes.append((x0, y - fs, x0 + w, y + fs * 0.25, content[:36]))
    return boxes


def _arc_points(x1, y1, rx, ry, rot_deg, large_arc, sweep, x2, y2, n=12):
    """Flatten an absolute SVG elliptical-arc command into n+1 points via
    the standard endpoint-to-center parametrization (SVG spec F.6.5), so
    curved elements (the confidence-gauge dial glyph, etc.) can be checked
    for crossing a label the same way straight segments already are."""
    if rx == 0 or ry == 0 or (x1 == x2 and y1 == y2):
        return [(x1, y1), (x2, y2)]
    phi = math.radians(rot_deg)
    cphi, sphi = math.cos(phi), math.sin(phi)
    dx, dy = (x1 - x2) / 2.0, (y1 - y2) / 2.0
    x1p = cphi * dx + sphi * dy
    y1p = -sphi * dx + cphi * dy
    rx, ry = abs(rx), abs(ry)
    lam = x1p ** 2 / rx ** 2 + y1p ** 2 / ry ** 2
    if lam > 1:
        s = math.sqrt(lam)
        rx, ry = rx * s, ry * s
    num = rx ** 2 * ry ** 2 - rx ** 2 * y1p ** 2 - ry ** 2 * x1p ** 2
    den = rx ** 2 * y1p ** 2 + ry ** 2 * x1p ** 2
    co = math.sqrt(max(0.0, num / den)) if den else 0.0
    if large_arc == sweep:
        co = -co
    cxp, cyp = co * rx * y1p / ry, co * -ry * x1p / rx
    cx = cphi * cxp - sphi * cyp + (x1 + x2) / 2.0
    cy = sphi * cxp + cphi * cyp + (y1 + y2) / 2.0

    def _ang(ux, uy, vx, vy):
        d = math.sqrt((ux ** 2 + uy ** 2) * (vx ** 2 + vy ** 2))
        a = math.acos(max(-1.0, min(1.0, (ux * vx + uy * vy) / d))) if d else 0.0
        return -a if ux * vy - uy * vx < 0 else a

    theta1 = _ang(1, 0, (x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry)
    dtheta = _ang((x1p - cxp) / rx, (y1p - cyp) / ry,
                  (-x1p - cxp) / rx, (-y1p - cyp) / ry)
    if not sweep and dtheta > 0:
        dtheta -= 2 * math.pi
    if sweep and dtheta < 0:
        dtheta += 2 * math.pi
    pts = []
    for i in range(n + 1):
        t = theta1 + dtheta * i / n
        pts.append((cx + rx * math.cos(t) * cphi - ry * math.sin(t) * sphi,
                    cy + rx * math.cos(t) * sphi + ry * math.sin(t) * cphi))
    return pts


def _polylines(svg: str):
    """Point-chains from <line> and absolute M/L/H/V/A path commands, each
    chain kept in drawing order (not flattened into loose segments) so a
    caller can tell a chain's true start/end from points merely sampled
    along the way — e.g. from arc flattening — which matters for "a line
    may end at a label, never cross it": that exemption must apply only to
    the chain's real endpoints, not to every synthetic arc sample point,
    or a curve that fully crosses a label (entering and exiting near its
    middle) would be wrongly waved through as if it were just landing."""
    chains = []
    for m in re.finditer(r"<line([^>]*?)/?>", svg):
        a = m.group(1)
        p = (_num(a, "x1"), _num(a, "y1"), _num(a, "x2"), _num(a, "y2"))
        if None not in p:
            chains.append([(p[0], p[1]), (p[2], p[3])])
    for m in re.finditer(r"\bd=['\"]([^'\"]+)", svg):
        toks = re.findall(r"([MLHVmlhvZzACSQTacsqt])|(-?\d+\.?\d*)", m.group(1))
        cmd = None
        nums = []
        chain = []
        for c, n in toks:
            if c:
                cmd, nums = c, []
                if c in "Zz" or c.islower() or c in "CSQTcsqt":
                    cmd = None  # only absolute M/L/H/V/A parts (agents draw
                                # exclusively in absolute coords in this style)
                continue
            if cmd is None:
                continue
            nums.append(float(n))
            if cmd == "M" and len(nums) == 2:
                if len(chain) > 1:
                    chains.append(chain)
                chain, nums = [(nums[0], nums[1])], []
            elif cmd == "L" and len(nums) == 2:
                chain.append((nums[0], nums[1]))
                nums = []
            elif cmd == "H" and len(nums) == 1:
                if chain:
                    chain.append((nums[0], chain[-1][1]))
                nums = []
            elif cmd == "V" and len(nums) == 1:
                if chain:
                    chain.append((chain[-1][0], nums[0]))
                nums = []
            elif cmd == "A" and len(nums) == 7:
                if chain:
                    cx, cy = chain[-1]
                    pts = _arc_points(cx, cy, nums[0], nums[1], nums[2],
                                       nums[3], nums[4], nums[5], nums[6])
                    chain.extend(pts[1:])
                nums = []
        if len(chain) > 1:
            chains.append(chain)
    return chains


def _clip_len(seg, box):
    """Length of seg inside box (Liang-Barsky)."""
    x1, y1, x2, y2 = seg
    bx0, by0, bx1, by1 = box[:4]
    dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
    t0, t1 = 0.0, 1.0
    for p, q in ((-dx, x1 - bx0), (dx, bx1 - x1), (-dy, y1 - by0), (dy, by1 - y1)):
        if p == 0:
            if q < 0:
                return 0.0
            continue
        t = q / p
        if p < 0:
            t0 = max(t0, t)
        else:
            t1 = min(t1, t)
        if t0 > t1:
            return 0.0
    return ((dx * (t1 - t0)) ** 2 + (dy * (t1 - t0)) ** 2) ** 0.5


def _inside(pt, box, pad=2.0):
    return (box[0] - pad <= pt[0] <= box[2] + pad
            and box[1] - pad <= pt[1] <= box[3] + pad)


def _strip_cam_terrain(svg: str) -> str:
    """Remove the frozen cam-terrain glyph (copied verbatim, own fixed
    colors/strokes) so style checks below only see the agent's own drawing."""
    m = re.search(r"<g[^>]*id=['\"]cam-terrain['\"][^>]*>.*?</g>", svg, re.S)
    return svg[: m.start()] + svg[m.end():] if m else svg


def check_style(svg: str) -> list[str]:
    """Palette / font / stroke-width / gradients-icons-emoji contract."""
    errs = []
    body = _strip_cam_terrain(svg)

    bad_colors = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r"(?:fill|stroke)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?(#[0-9a-fA-F]{3,8})",
                          body):
        c = m.group(1).lower()
        rgb = c[:7]  # ignore an 8-digit hex's trailing alpha byte
        if rgb not in _PALETTE:
            bad_colors.add(c)
    for c in sorted(bad_colors)[:5]:
        errs.append(f"color {c} is not in the palette "
                     f"({', '.join(sorted(_PALETTE))}, optionally +alpha)")

    fonts = set()
    for m in re.finditer(r"font-family\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?([^'\";]+)", svg):
        fonts.add(re.sub(r"\s*,\s*", ",", m.group(1).strip()).lower())
    if not fonts:
        errs.append("missing font-family (expected Palatino,Georgia,serif)")
    else:
        for f in sorted(fonts - {_FONT}):
            errs.append(f"font-family '{f}' must be Palatino,Georgia,serif")

    lo, hi = _STROKE_RANGE
    for m in re.finditer(r"stroke-width\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?([\d.]+)", body):
        w = float(m.group(1))
        if not lo <= w <= hi:
            errs.append(f"stroke-width {w} outside ~{lo}-{hi} "
                        "(spec: ~1.2 elements, 1 arrows)")

    if re.search(r"<(linearGradient|radialGradient)\b", svg, re.I):
        errs.append("no gradients allowed — fills only flat colors/tints")
    if re.search(r"<image\b", svg, re.I):
        errs.append("no images/icons allowed — draw everything in ink")

    for m in re.finditer(r"<text[^>]*>(.*?)</text>", svg, re.S):
        text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", m.group(1))
        for ch in text:
            cp = ord(ch)
            if any(lo <= cp <= hi for lo, hi in _EMOJI_RANGES):
                errs.append(f"emoji-range character {ch!r} found in text "
                            "— no emoji")
                break
    return errs[:15]


def check_changed_consistency(svg: str, stages) -> list[str]:
    """Coarse necessary condition for 'red only for what changed': red
    present iff some stage is marked changed. Cannot verify red sits on
    the RIGHT element — only that it isn't used gratuitously or omitted."""
    if not stages:
        return []
    any_changed = any(s.get("changed") for s in stages if isinstance(s, dict))
    red_present = bool(re.search(
        rf"(?:fill|stroke)\s*[:=]\s*['\"]?{re.escape(_RED)}\b", svg, re.I))
    if any_changed and not red_present:
        return [f"a stage is marked changed but {_RED} (red) never "
                "appears in the figure"]
    if not any_changed and red_present:
        return [f"no stage is marked changed but {_RED} (red) appears — "
                "red is reserved for exactly what this experiment changed"]
    return []


def check_layout(svg: str) -> list[str]:
    """Geometric readability checks: text-on-text and line-through-label."""
    errs = []
    boxes = _text_boxes(svg)
    for i in range(len(boxes)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(boxes)):
            a, b = boxes[i], boxes[j]
            ox = min(a[2], b[2]) - max(a[0], b[0])
            oy = min(a[3], b[3]) - max(a[1], b[1])
            if ox > 3.0 and oy > 3.0:
                errs.append(f"text overlap: '{a[4]}' vs '{b[4]}'")
    for chain in _polylines(svg):
        for box in boxes:
            clipped = sum(_clip_len((p1[0], p1[1], p2[0], p2[1]), box)
                          for p1, p2 in zip(chain, chain[1:]))
            if clipped <= 12.0:
                continue
            # A line/curve may legitimately END at a label (a leader line
            # landing on a caption) — exempt only when the chain's TRUE
            # start or end point (not a synthetic arc-sample point) sits in
            # the box and the total clipped length is little more than just
            # that tip; anything clipping substantially more is passing
            # through the label, not landing on it.
            tip = ((_inside(chain[0], box) or _inside(chain[-1], box))
                   and clipped <= 16.0)
            if tip:
                continue
            errs.append(f"line crosses label '{box[4]}'")
    return errs[:10]


def check(svg: str) -> list[str]:
    errs = []
    m = re.search(r"viewBox=['\"]\s*0[ ,]+0[ ,]+980[ ,]+(\d+)", svg)
    if not m:
        errs.append("viewBox must be exactly '0 0 980 H' (width is fixed at 980)")
    else:
        h = int(m.group(1))
        if not 240 <= h <= 640:
            errs.append(f"viewBox height {h} outside 240-640 — grow height for "
                        "breathing room, never width")

    tag = re.search(r"<[^>]*id=['\"]frozen-input['\"][^>]*>", svg)
    if not tag:
        errs.append("missing id='frozen-input' on the camera-frame element (x=26)")
    elif not re.search(r"\bx=['\"]26['\"]", tag.group(0)):
        errs.append("frozen-input element must sit at x=26 (left-flush anchor)")

    if not re.search(r"id=['\"]cam-terrain['\"]", svg):
        errs.append("camera frame must be the canonical terrain glyph from the "
                    "prompt (missing <g id='cam-terrain'>) — copy it verbatim")
    tag = re.search(r"<[^>]*id=['\"]frozen-output['\"][^>]*>", svg)
    if not tag:
        errs.append("missing id='frozen-output' on the output text block "
                    "(x=828, text-anchor='start')")
    else:
        if not re.search(r"\bx=['\"]828['\"]", tag.group(0)):
            errs.append("frozen-output must sit at x=828 (right anchor)")
        if "text-anchor='start'" not in tag.group(0) and \
           'text-anchor="start"' not in tag.group(0):
            errs.append("frozen-output must use text-anchor='start'")
    return errs


def main() -> int:
    src = Path(sys.argv[1]) if len(sys.argv) > 1 else \
        REPO_ROOT / "runs" / "pending_experiment.json"
    if not src.exists():
        print(f"figcheck: {src} not found")
        return 1
    text = src.read_text()
    stages = None
    if src.suffix == ".json":
        d = json.loads(text)
        svg = d.get("architecture_svg", "")
        stages = d.get("architecture", {}).get("stages")
    else:
        svg = text
    if not svg.strip():
        print("figcheck: no architecture_svg found")
        return 1
    errs = (check(svg) + check_style(svg) + check_changed_consistency(svg, stages)
            + check_layout(svg))
    if errs:
        for e in errs:
            print(f"figcheck FAIL: {e}")
        return 1
    print("figcheck PASS")
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    sys.exit(main())
